The War Within · Patch 11.2.5
Expected client build: 63704
Draconic WoW 11.2.5 · 127.0.0.1
Downloadable/importable local server

Installing or importing replaces this expansion’s selected component, including its executables. Back up existing Draconic databases before replacing the server repack. Other expansions use separate folders.

Download & Install obtains the publisher’s streaming mini-client for build 63704 directly in the app. Game assets download during play; internet access is required. Existing complete clients can still be imported from Installation Options.
Download and install additional map files
ZIP, 7z (including BCJ2) and RAR archives are extracted automatically. Existing installations are kept until validation passes.
Choose the installation directory before importing. Android grants access to these managed directories. Existing files are preserved when changing this setting is unavailable.
The directory cannot be changed while an installation or server is present, a job is running, or external storage is unavailable.

Downloads use a separate temporary directory. Cancelled transfers can resume when the source supports it. Retry a failed action to reuse verified files. Drive access, quotas, and unavailable links are reported as errors.
The normal shutdown did not finish. Force Stop terminates this Windows session and may lose unsaved world or database changes. Verify the database before starting it again.

Configure the imported client and server for 127.0.0.1. Configuration files are backed up. Executables are never replaced or patched. Firestorm clients can include connection restrictions; the expected build alone does not prove that they can connect to Draconic.
Local connection configuration saved. Use Verify to review remaining issues.

The Windows repack uses the existing Wine/Box64 runtime in its own container. Startup requires detected programs, database configuration, matching client data, and available local ports. Component status comes from the running session and network checks. Phone compatibility must be confirmed with the installed files.
Firestorm-specific files or settings were detected. Review local connection configuration before launching.
Stop the local realm that is running (Legion or The War Within) before starting another game. They share the Windows runtime.
Installs a streaming client (about 63 MB), the server and maps. Assets download as you play. The app sets the local connection; executables are not patched.
